what: an R4 round on the rim of an R5 notch where its cylinder meets an extruded B-spline ramp, both ends running into a square wall
method: a plate extruded from a profile with a cubic B-spline ramp, a 30 mm slot with an R5 half-round relief notch cut through it; the edge where the notch cylinder meets the ramp is an ordinary smooth-surface convex edge with room for R4 (the same fillet works on a flat top and in another CAD). No closed form for the removed volume, so only validity is graded: one closed valid solid.
